nodes.summary: Let $k$, $n$ and $h$ be natural numbers with $k > 1$, $h \ge 1$ and $n \ge kh - 1$, and let $\varphi$ be Euler's totient function. The number of integers $b$ with $1 \le b \le n$, $\gcd(h, b) = 1$ and $1/k < h/b \le 1/(k-1)$ is $\varphi(h)$. If moreover $h > 2$, then twice the number of integers $b$ with $1 \le b \le n$, $\gcd(h, b) = 1$ and $1/k < h/b < 2/(2k-1)$ is $\varphi(h)$.
